id: 08_How To Inspect Welding Machine Inspection of Welding Machine HSE STUDY GUIDE
title: 如何检查电焊机
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/08_How To Inspect Welding Machine Inspection of Welding Machine HSE STUDY GUIDE.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/08_How To Inspect Welding Machine Inspection of Welding Machine HSE STUDY GUIDE/src.py

points.K1: 新来、调来的焊机，先检查
points.K5: 电缆接头用接线鼻，压牢

shots.scene: 欣欣站在车间一台黄色移动式电焊机旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to a yellow wheeled welding machine in a factory workshop and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲电焊机使用前怎样检查。

shots.scene: 放大镜在焊机图标上移动，旁边出现空白清单
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass icon moves over a welding machine icon next to a blank checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 一台焊机，十个检查点。

shots.scene: 阿杰从隔壁车间推来一台旧焊机，准备直接插电
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wheels an old welding machine in from the next workshop and reaches for the power cable to plug it in.
shots.narration: 阿杰从隔壁推来一台旧焊机，想直接用。

shots.scene: 焊机电缆外皮开裂的特写图标，带黄色警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A close-up icon of a welding cable with a cracked outer jacket and a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 可这台焊机，电缆已经裂了口子。

shots.scene: 老李拦住阿杰，手里拿着空白检查表
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stops the young male student, holding up a blank inspection checklist on a clipboard.
shots.narration: 老李拦住他：先检查，合格再用。

shots.section_title: 新来、调来的焊机，先检查
shots.scene: 新焊机从包装箱推出、旧焊机从别处推来两个图标，中间是放大镜
shots.prompt_en: Two icons, a new welding machine coming out of a crate and an old one being wheeled in, with a magnifying glass between them. No people.
shots.narration: 新到的焊机，或从别处调来的旧焊机。
overlay: 新来、调来的焊机，先检查

shots.section_title: 新来、调来的焊机，先检查
shots.scene: 焊机图标前横着一道关卡，上面有对勾
shots.prompt_en: A welding machine icon stopped at a barrier gate with a blank check mark sign. No people.
shots.narration: 投入使用前，都要先检查一遍。

shots.scene: 焊机面板特写，开关旋钮被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of the welding machine front panel with the power switch knob circled in green. No people.
shots.narration: 第一看：焊机有没有电源开关。

shots.scene: 没有开关、电线直接接着的焊机图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a welding machine with no switch and bare wires hooked straight to it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没有开关，出事时就没法马上断电。

shots.scene: 老李转动开关，检查旋钮是否松动
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer turns the power switch knob on the welding machine to check that it is firm.
shots.narration: 开关要完好，转动灵活不松脱。

shots.scene: 开关外壳开裂的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cracked switch housing with a red X over it. No people.
shots.narration: 外壳破裂、绝缘不好的，不能用。

shots.scene: 焊机电流调节旋钮和刻度条特写
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of the current adjustment knob on the welding machine with a blank scale bar beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第二看：调节器有没有指示刻度。

shots.scene: 刻度模糊看不清的旋钮图标，旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an adjustment knob with a faded unreadable scale and a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 看不清刻度，电流就调不准。

shots.section_title: 电缆接头用接线鼻，压牢
shots.scene: 电缆端头压着金属接线鼻，用螺栓固定在焊机端子上
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of a welding cable end with a crimped metal cable lug bolted firmly onto the machine output terminal. No people.
shots.narration: 电缆接焊机，要用接线鼻压接。
overlay: 电缆接头用接线鼻，压牢

shots.section_title: 电缆接头用接线鼻，压牢
shots.scene: 老李用扳手拧紧接线端子
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tightens the output terminal bolt with a wrench.
shots.narration: 接头拧紧，不松不晃。

shots.section_title: 电缆接头用接线鼻，压牢
shots.scene: 铜丝直接缠在端子上、冒火花的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of bare copper strands twisted around a terminal with sparks, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 铜丝直接缠上去，容易发热打火。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴手套捋过整根焊接电缆检查
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wearing gloves runs his hands along the whole length of a welding cable to inspect it.
shots.narration: 焊接电缆从头到尾捋一遍。

shots.scene: 破皮露铜的电缆图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a welding cable with torn insulation and exposed copper, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝缘有破损、露铜的，必须换掉。

shots.scene: 焊钳和接地夹两个图标并排
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an electrode holder and a ground clamp side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 再看焊钳和接地夹。

shots.scene: 焊钳绝缘外壳缺损的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an electrode holder with a chipped insulating shell, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 外壳缺损、夹口变形，都要更换。

shots.scene: 焊机电源线末端是带接地的工业插头，插入工业插座
shots.prompt_en: The welding machine power cable ending in an industrial plug with a ground pin, inserted into a matching industrial socket. No people.
shots.narration: 焊机电源，要用工业插头插座。

shots.scene: 裸线头直接塞进插座的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of bare wire ends pushed straight into a socket, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能用裸线头直接插。

shots.scene: 焊机外壳盖板齐全、螺丝拧紧的图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a welding machine with all cover panels in place and screws tightened, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 焊机外壳要完整，盖板都装好。

shots.scene: 侧板缺失、露出内部线路的焊机图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a welding machine with a missing side panel exposing internal wiring, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 里面的带电部件，绝不能露出来。

shots.scene: 配电箱里带试验按钮的漏电断路器图标，连向焊机
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an earth leakage circuit breaker with a test button in a distribution box, wired to the welding machine. No people.
shots.narration: 焊机电源要用30毫安的ELCB。

shots.scene: 漏电断路器跳闸、闪电被挡住的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an earth leakage circuit breaker tripping and a shield blocking a lightning bolt. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦漏电，它会立即切断电源。

shots.scene: 焊机小车底部和车轮特写
shots.prompt_en: A close-up of the wheeled trolley base of the welding machine and its wheels. No people.
shots.narration: 最后看小车和车轮。

shots.scene: 车轮断裂、焊机歪倒的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a welding machine tipping over on a broken wheel, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 轮子坏了，推动时容易翻倒。

shots.scene: 空白清单上十个格子依次打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with ten boxes being checked one by one with green ticks. No people.
shots.narration: 这些点要逐项核对，一个不漏。

shots.scene: 老李对阿杰点头，焊机旁亮起绿灯
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer nods to the young male student as a green light icon appears beside the welding machine.
shots.narration: 全部合格，焊机才能投入使用。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊机旁，指着空白清单
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the welding machine and points at a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 开关、调节器，先看操作部分。

shots.scene: 电缆、接线鼻、焊钳、接地夹图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a welding cable, a cable lug, an electrode holder and a ground clamp, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 电缆、接头、焊钳、接地夹查完好。

shots.scene: 工业插头、封闭外壳、漏电断路器、车轮图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an industrial plug, a closed machine casing, an earth leakage circuit breaker and a wheel, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 插头、外壳、ELCB、车轮都别漏。

shots.scene: 空白清单上的格子全部打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist with every box ticked green. No people.
shots.narration: 每一点都核对过，焊机才能用。

shots.scene: 欣欣和老李、阿杰站在检查合格的焊机旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera together with the facility engineer and the young male student beside the inspected welding machine.
shots.narration: 先检查再焊接，安全每一天，再见！
